## SPEC: APPROVE

1. **Deterministic Observation Comparator Contract:**
   - [`first_difference`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/compare.rs#L93-L135) inspects two present borrowed [`TraceView`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/compare.rs#L30-L34) instances in exact specification order:
     1. `IdentityField::Profile` (L97–99) and `IdentityField::SourceSha256` (L100–102);
     2. `TraceDifference::Initial(SnapshotField)` via [`snapshot_difference`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/compare.rs#L137-L157) across all 8 [`Snapshot`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/reference_types.rs#L156-L165) fields (`Program`, `Control`, `Environment`, `Frames`, `StackLimit`, `RemainingFuel`, `InitialFuel`, `Outcome`);
     3. `TraceDifference::Record { index, field }` in ascending index order over the shared prefix (L106–126), checking `RuleStartLine`, `Charge`, `Before(SnapshotField)`, then `After(SnapshotField)`;
     4. `TraceDifference::Length { common_records, left_records, right_records }` when slice lengths differ after an equal common prefix (L127–133).
   - Equality is typed structural equality through `Arc` (`left.program.as_ref() != right.program.as_ref()` at L138, plus derived `PartialEq` on [`Program`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/reference_types.rs#L96-L99), [`Expr`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/reference_types.rs#L71-L80), [`Tree`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/reference_types.rs#L14-L17), [`Frame`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/reference_types.rs#L102-L112), and [`Control`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/reference_types.rs#L115-L126)). Raw values are preserved uncopied in the caller's `TraceView`.

2. **Security Boundary & Non-Claims (Argon Security Judgment):**
   - **H1 Structural Traversal Risk:** Derived `PartialEq` on recursive `Arc<Expr>`, `Arc<Tree>`, and `Box<Control>` performs unbounded host call-stack recursion and value traversal without DAG pointer deduplication or host time/depth admission limits. [`compare.rs`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/compare.rs#L14-L16) and [`SHERLOCK-REFERENCE-STATUS.md`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/docs/SHERLOCK-REFERENCE-STATUS.md#L42-L43) accurately document that H1 remains in force and untrusted inputs remain prohibited.
   - **Zero Validation/Authentication Authority:** [`compare.rs`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/compare.rs#L3-L21) and [`compare.rs`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/compare.rs#L90-L91) explicitly state that `first_difference(..) == None` does not validate step-to-step state continuity (`initial == records[0].before` or `records[i].after == records[i+1].before`), `Machine` counter invariants (`remaining_fuel <= initial_fuel`), rule execution, source-hash authenticity, cross-profile clock alignment, or ZK constraints/proofs. An empty `records` slice is a zero-step observation, not a missing K/Quint/Lean/Clean/circuit layer.
